card.name: Instruct patients to check insulin label
card.fires_on: The words 'to' or 'always' right before 'check the insulin label' in insulin medication-error warnings. It also fires on a few odd spots, such as a repeated 'fig' list.

modes.label: Insulin label-check warning
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'always' just before 'check the insulin label' in the mix-up warning for insulin products.
modes.example: To avoid medication errors between KIRSTY and other insulins, instruct patients to<< always>> check the insulin label before each injection.

modes.label: Odd list or command text
modes.description: A space in a repeated figure list, or 'and' between two command names in a man-page sentence.
modes.example: through man pages you may use two commands: whatis<< and>> apropos.

card.writes: It pushes down label-related words such as 'label' and 'advertise', so it seems to hold back the word 'label' one step before it would appear.
card.plain: It fires in the insulin warning just before the instruction to check the label.
evidence: To avoid medication errors between HUMALOG and other insulins, instruct patients to<< always>> check the insulin label before each injection.
